newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Companion in US$12 mln convertible loan.
newsitem.headline: Companion in US$12 mln convertible loan.

text.p: Companion Building Material (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday a third party has agreed to advance a US$12 million convertible loan to the company's wholly-owned subsidiary Companion China Ltd.

The loan carries an interest rate of 9.8 percent per annum compounded annually for a term of six years and the third party has the right to convert the loan into shares of Companion Building or Companion China, the statement said.
The third party, Simonson International Development Ltd, is a wholly-owned unit of ING Beijing Investment Co Ltd.

Under the agreement, Simonson has the right to convert the loan and the accrued interest into 30 percent of the enlarged issued share capital of Companion China at any time during the terms as full repayment of the loan and interest.

Simonson also has the right to convert the loan and accrued interest into Companion Holdings shares not exceeding 20 percent of the enlarged share capital. The balance which has not been converted will be repaid in one lump sum in cash.

Simonson has the right to call for repayment of the loan and the accured interest, with 50 percent of the loan and interest to be repaid on the first anniversary of the date of the repayment and the balance on the second anniversary.
